entities.label: Place
entities.summary:
Maligrad is an island situated deep within the Albanian part of Lake Prespa, with many caves suitable for wildlife and a circular
cliff. Shaped like a tadpole, it contains some trees and an area of sand. The island contains a famous Saint Mary Church, built by Kesar Novak, a local noble, in 1369. It has an area of almost 5 hectares.
